title: Switching an output on for a freely selectable time
body_md: An output can be switched on for a duration of your choice between 1 and 120 minutes. The desired number of minutes is inserted into the message. Pro-finder switches the output on for that duration and sends a status report.
prev_context: Before this stands the pulsed mode.
next_context: The red note on the second output follows.
change_reason: Extracted from the English source page itself, not translated from the German master, and cross-read against the German page 23: equivalent in substance, including the range of 1 to 120 minutes. Neither version says what happens outside that range. The command structure is not reproduced (BLK-005).
